Markets.title: SME IPO: Liqvd Digital India issue to open on Sep 23; price band fixed at Rs 51-54
Markets.summary: Liqvd Digital India's Rs 39-crore SME initial public offering will run from September 23 to September 25 with a price band of Rs 51 to Rs 54 per share. The company plans to use the proceeds from the BSE SME platform listing to acquire a video content production hub.

Markets.title: Gold likely to stay range-bound next week as dollar, West Asia tensions guide market: Analysts
Markets.summary: Gold prices are expected to remain range-bound next week, influenced by currency movements and West Asia tensions. Investors will shift their focus to upcoming mid-month manufacturing and services PMI data from major economies.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Acme Solar, Medanta among 5 stock recommendations for Monday
Markets.summary: Indian equities extended their recovery as softer crude prices and global yields improved market risk appetite. Analysts have recommended five stocks with bullish technical setups: ACME Solar, Medanta, Tilaknagar Industries, Uno Minda, and PWL.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk | India may see 50 bps of rate hikes in 2026 as Fed tightens: Garima Kapoor
Markets.summary: Elara Securities economist Garima Kapoor predicts the Reserve Bank of India will raise interest rates by 25 to 50 basis points in 2026 as the US Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy. This US tightening is expected to narrow India-US bond yield differentials and potentially pressure foreign portfolio investor flows into India due to higher US yields and a stronger dollar.

Markets.title: Rs 23,000 crore outflows! Is the September FII rout indicating a worse end to 2026?
Markets.summary: Foreign investors pulled over Rs 23,000 crore from Indian equities between September 1 and September 19 due to rising crude prices, US bond yields, and geopolitical risks. Domestic institutional investors are currently helping cushion the market against these ongoing foreign outflows.

Geo-Political.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
Geo-Political.summary: Exit polls indicate that German Chancellor Merz's centre-right CDU party suffered damaging losses in the Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state elections. Although Merz described the outcome as a disaster, he vowed to remain in his position.

Geo-Political.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine launched 450 drones at Moscow in the largest attack on the city yet, resulting in the downing of the aircraft and two deaths. Moscow's mayor reported that the overnight barrage caused casualties during the massive aerial assault.

Geo-Political.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
Geo-Political.summary: Ed Sheeran addressed past mistakes during his first concert since rapper Macklemore was removed from his tour. Macklemore had been dropped following pro-Palestinian remarks made on stage regarding Israel and Gaza.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says triumphal arch will be military complex with drones and snipers
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump announced that the proposed triumphal arch will be redesigned as a military complex featuring drones and snipers. He stated that the US military requested these updated plans for national security purposes.

Geo-Political.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
Geo-Political.summary: Saudi Arabia intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh that was reportedly launched by Houthi forces. The resulting strike on a fuel depot at the Riyadh airport caused flight delays on Saturday.

Geo-Political.title: Converse pulls 'deeply upsetting' advert after backlash
Geo-Political.summary: Converse removed an Instagram advertisement after social media users complained that the image resembled a Ku Klux Klan hood and a hanging. The brand stated that the advertisement was deeply upsetting and apologized for the content.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top organic result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is changing the landscape of organic web traffic compared to traditional SEO.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has launched an AI Studio that allows users to generate AI content. The platform also provides creators with tools to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: China drives India’s BRICS export surge to $19.9 billion; shipments to Japan, Italy, S Korea also gain
Data & Insights.summary: India's exports to BRICS nations surged 34% from April to August 2026, led by a 39% increase in shipments to China. During the same period, exports to Japan rose 43%, driven largely by energy products and electronics.

Data & Insights.title: Why does India need to save more?
Data & Insights.summary: India needs a higher savings rate to sustain its 7-8% economic growth. This capital is necessary for ongoing investments in infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, technology, housing, and human capital.

Data & Insights.title: Saudi Arabia exits mBridge: Can China-led platform still challenge US dollar, become global cross-border payment system?
Data & Insights.summary: Saudi Arabia quietly withdrew from the China-led mBridge digital currency project in 2025 as originally planned. Despite this exit, the platform continues to expand its efforts to enable faster cross-border payments and reduce reliance on the US dollar and SWIFT.

Data & Insights.title: Food prices stable as pulses, cereals output rises; sugar rates ease
Data & Insights.summary: Driven by higher output of major crops, pulses production rose to a record 27.4 million tonnes and cereals production increased by about 5% in 2025-26. Consequently, food prices remained stable while sugar rates eased.

Data & Insights.title: Industry has to follow the consumer, says FSSAI chief on food-safety push
Data & Insights.summary: The FSSAI chief stated that the food industry must adapt to consumer needs while increasing safety regulations. The agency is expanding its oversight to focus on e-commerce, product labelling, and school food safety.

Data & Insights.title: The week ahead in numbers: Credit growth, flash PMI, Fed signals
Data & Insights.summary: This report previews key economic developments, data releases, and market events for the upcoming week. It highlights critical metrics such as credit growth, flash Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data, and signals from the Federal Reserve.

India.title: Trustees Put On Notice By Government: Harish Salve On Listing Row At Tatas
India.summary: Senior advocate Harish Salve stated that the Indian government has put Tata group trustees on notice regarding the public listing of their holding structures. This regulatory action challenges the trustees' attempt to control the multi-billion-dollar empire without complying with standard listing requirements.

India.title: 'Runaway Board': Abhishek Singhvi Backs Tata Trusts' 'Shareholder Primacy'
India.summary: Senior lawyer Abhishek Manu Singhvi stated that a corporate board cannot act independently from its majority shareholder. He made this remark in support of Tata Trusts, which owns 66 percent of the Tata conglomerate.

India.title: Man Electrocuted During Ganesh Idol Immersion In Mumbai
India.summary: A worker named Rohit Bhimu Rathod was electrocuted at Shyam Nagar Lake in Mumbai. The incident occurred in the afternoon when he entered a closed artificial pond during a Ganesh idol immersion.

India.title: Bengaluru Man Flashes Dagger In Public, Attempts To Kill, Gets Arrested
India.summary: A Bengaluru man was arrested after a viral video showed him riding a two-wheeler while flashing a dagger and threatening people in public. The incident, which occurred on September 19, caused widespread panic among the local community.

India.title: "Our Average Cost Will Come Down": Himanta Sarma On Adani Power Project
India.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Sarma told NDTV that a new Adani power project will be the largest power plant in the Northeast. He stated that the project will help lower the region's average power generation cost.

India.title: 'Gen Z Speed': Jeet Adani Praises Himanta Sarma's Energy, Calls Assam 'Home'
India.summary: Jeet Adani praised Assam Chief Minister Himanta Sarma's energetic approach to development, which has shaped the Adani Group's experience working in the state. He also referred to Assam as his "home."

General.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
General.summary: German Chancellor Merz called his centre-right CDU party's performance in recent state elections a disaster following damaging losses in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Despite the poor results shown in exit polls, Merz vowed to remain in his position.

General.title: Key takeaways from BBC interview as Earl Spencer defends claims about King
General.summary: Earl Spencer defended claims he made about the King during an interview with the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg. The interview took place ahead of the publication of his new book about his sister, Diana, Princess of Wales.

General.title: Watch: Emotional Earl Spencer says he misses sister Diana every day
General.summary: Earl Spencer told presenter Laura Kuenssberg that he misses his sister, Princess Diana, every day during what he described as his final public words about her. He made the emotional remarks while appearing on a broadcast with presenter Laura Kuenssberg.

General.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
General.summary: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow, involving approximately 450 drones intercepted overnight by air defenses. The massive bombardment resulted in the deaths of two people in the Russian capital.

General.title: Burnham hails Greenland deal ahead of expected first Trump meeting
General.summary: Andy Burnham praised a new Greenland agreement before his anticipated first meeting with Donald Trump. Meanwhile, Liberal Democrat leader Ed Davey dismissed the deal as a pretend victory for Trump.

General.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
General.summary: Ed Sheeran addressed recent "mistakes" during his first concert since rapper Macklemore was removed from his tour lineup. Macklemore had been dropped following controversial pro-Palestinian stage remarks regarding the Israel-Gaza conflict.
